baseline_comparison.comparison_notes: The ML model provides continuous calibrated risk probabilities, while the baseline rules provide transparent heuristic scoring. Both are surfaced distinctly in the API.

held_out_victim_cases.notes: Victim drained during APP scam. Evaluating false-positive risk.

victim_and_innocent_analysis.innocent_protection_notes: Compromised victims and legitimate accounts connected to suspicious flows require dual review. Statistical models can conflate high victim drainage with perpetrator volume.

disclaimer: Decision support only. Model trained exclusively on synthetic financial network scenarios. High model risk scores do NOT constitute legal proof of guilt or real-world fraud accuracy. Automated account freezing, denial of service, or punitive action is strictly prohibited.
